question: Should Mattermost adopt automatic acknowledgments under the existing shared ack-reaction default and identity fallback, or should this channel remain opt-in until a separate product policy is approved?
rationale: This is a user-visible default behavior change for existing Mattermost deployments, and the repository policy treats config/default and fallback behavior as compatibility-sensitive; implementation quality cannot determine the intended product default.

options.title: Adopt channel parity
options.body: Approve Mattermost automatic acks under the established shared policy, then require a current-main rebase, conflict cleanup, and updated upgrade-focused proof.

options.title: Keep Mattermost opt-in
options.body: Require a product-approved opt-in design that does not activate automatic reaction writes for existing Mattermost configurations by default.

recommendation.title: Adopt channel parity
recommendation.body: Approve Mattermost automatic acks under the established shared policy, then require a current-main rebase, conflict cleanup, and updated upgrade-focused proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The contributor has the most direct implementation context, although the actual default-policy decision should be made by the relevant channel/product owner.
